subject: Aurora Health - security & IAM follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, SSO/SCIM evidence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurora-health.org>, Daniel Park <dpark@aurora-health.org>
Cc: Aurora Security <security@aurora-health.org>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Health - security & IAM follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, SSO/SCIM evidence

Hi Lena / Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo and the candid discussion today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep the security review moving: 

1) High-level asks from Aurora
   - Confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and whether a Type II report is available (or an SOC 2 summary/bridge letter).
   - Clarify GDPR data residency and data processing agreements; confirm support for EU regions if needed.
   - Confirm Redwood's stance on HIPAA and BAA availability for PHI workloads.

2) IAM / Access controls Aurora specifically requested
   - SSO: SAML metadata (IdP metadata + Redwood SP metadata) and a sample SAML assertion mapping for email/name/role.
   - SCIM: provisioning API spec and attribute mapping (users / groups).
   - RBAC: admin roles, separation of duties, and an export of recent admin audit events (last 90 days).
   - Admin controls: MFA for admin accounts, user onboarding/offboarding workflows, and emergency access procedures.

3) Evidence we can provide quickly (attached template)
   - SOC2 summary, security intake template (attached), and a short SAML/SCIM configuration guide.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm which artifacts you want first (SOC2 report, SAML metadata, SCIM API docs, or admin audit logs).
- If you need a BAA, let us know so I can route to Legal/PM to get a draft DocuSign ready.
- I can put Marissa on this thread to send SOC2/controls summary and Neha for SSO/SCIM config details.

Target: return preliminary artifacts within 3 business days (we can escalate timelines as needed).

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_security_intake_template.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Aurora Health - security & IAM follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, SSO/SCIM evidence

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap. For Aurora the highest priority is: 1) SOC 2 evidence (Type II if available or an up-to-date bridge summary), 2) SSO metadata + SCIM API docs so our IdP team can validate, and 3) confirmation on HIPAA/BAA options.

We also have a brief vendor security questionnaire (attached) — could you review and fill the technical sections (SSO, provisioning, access controls) or point us to the right artifacts? If it's easier, we can take the SOC2 summary and SAML metadata first and loop in our IdP team for a test.

One note: we will need admin audit logs showing changes to role assignments for the last 90 days; masked PII is fine. Also, please call out whether any customer data is processed outside the US.

Thanks — look forward to the artifacts.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Vendor Risk Management
Aurora Health

Marissa / Neha —

Forwarding Aurora's questionnaire and their ask. Can you please coordinate to deliver the items below? Short timeline: Aurora wants preliminary artifacts ASAP; target is EOD Wednesday Pacific but escalate if you need Legal or Infra.

Action items:
- Marissa: please prepare a 1-2 page SOC 2 controls summary (scope, period, cert status) and a PDF summary we can share. Also indicate where the Redwood SOC 2 report can be requested under NDA.
- Neha: produce SAML SP metadata, a sample assertion mapping (email/name/role), SCIM API endpoint summary, and the RBAC admin roles export (last 90 days audit sample). If any of the admin logs contain PII, mask before sending.
- Karthik (me): I'll coordinate the BAA/DocuSign if Aurora confirms they need it and will own external follow-up. HubSpot deal is 112233-AURORA — use that ID for any tracking.

Please cc: lena and daniel on deliverables. If either of you anticipate >3 business days to assemble, flag now and I'll request an extension.
